thought.text: JDK 17 installed. Now Maven 3.9 (apt only has 3.6, project requires 3.9):

reasoning_content: JDK 17 is installed. Next up is Maven 3.9. Ubuntu 22.04's apt has Maven 3.6.3, but the project requires Maven 3.9. I'll download the Maven 3.9.x binary from Apache.

action.command: cd /opt && curl -sSL -o maven.tgz https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.11/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.11-bin.tar.gz && tar xzf maven.tgz && ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-3.9.11/bin/mvn /usr/local/bin/mvn && rm maven.tgz && mvn -version 2>&1 | head -3

tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /opt && curl -sSL -o maven.tgz https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/3.9.11/binaries/apache-maven-3.9.11-bin.tar.gz && tar xzf maven.tgz && ln -sf /opt/apache-maven-3.9.11/bin/mvn /usr/local/bin/mvn && rm maven.tgz && mvn -version 2>&1 | head -3", "summary": "Download and install Maven 3.9.11", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
